versions.subject: Rule Update (Batch 2)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\gpscript.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'GPSCRIPT.EXE'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /logon'
        - ' /startup'
condition: all of selection*

versions.subject: Fix svchost FP
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\gpscript.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'GPSCRIPT.EXE'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /logon'
        - ' /startup'
filter_svchost:
    ParentCommandLine: 'C:\windows\system32\svchost.exe -k netsvcs -p -s gpsvc'
condition: all of selection* and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\gpscript.exe" OR OriginalFileName="GPSCRIPT.EXE" CommandLine IN ("* /logon*", "* /startup*") NOT ParentCommandLine="C:\\windows\\system32\\svchost.exe -k netsvcs -p -s gpsvc"
